text: Oh, hey there. Im assuming you're new here, so I'll show you around the place.
Not because I want to though, my boss would get mad at me.
First, if you need help picking a song, navigate through the record by pressing the *Up Arrow or Down Arrow* keys.
Changing the difficulty of your song is about the same, just press the *Left Arrow or Right Arrow* keys to suit your liking.
Your difficulty will show up in the top left.
And if you ever wanna talk again for some reason, *press T on your keyboard*.
